== English errata comparison sources ==
The Limited face deploys on the pilot, and the Revised face returns a pilot after a starfighter is lost. The PC replacement deploys on the location and stacks the pilot. The January 2013 slip prints that PC wording with the header Effect. The June 2017 slip, like the complete PC faces and original and Revised faces, labels the card Immediate Effect. The comparison date refers to the replacement game text.
